title: Cinematic Cameraman
description: Transforms a player into an automatic cinematic camera. Features auto-rotation, mob targeting, and dynamic perspectives like Orbit, Flyby, and Crane. Perfect for live streams and server showcases.
body:
# Cinematic Cameraman

**Capture the beauty of your Minecraft world automatically.**

Cinematic Cameraman is a Paper plugin that transforms a designated player into an intelligent, automated camera operator. Whether you are running a 24/7 live stream, creating a server trailer, or simply want to showcase your community's builds, this plugin handles the camera work for you with professional-grade movements.

## 🔴 Live Demo
See the plugin in action right now on our 24/7 YouTube Live stream:
[**Watch Live on YouTube**](https://l.32keta.com/smp)

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🎥 Professional Camera Movements
Forget static views. The plugin automatically switches between various cinematic perspectives to keep the visuals engaging:
* **Orbit:** Smoothly circles around players or targets.
* **Flyby:** Simulates a drone flying past the subject.
* **Crane:** Vertical sweeping shots perfect for architectural builds.
* **Dynamic:** A "spring-arm" tracking shot that smooths out player movements.
* **Scenic Mode:** Captures the landscape itself when no players are around.

### 🤖 Fully Automated
* **Auto-Rotation:** Cycles through online players automatically.
* **Smart Targeting:** If no players are online, it intelligently switches to spectating mobs or scenic views.
* **Smooth Transitions:** No jarring cuts. The camera interpolates positions smoothly when switching targets.
* **Persistence:** The cameraman's state is saved and restored even after server restarts or disconnects.

### 🛠️ For Server Admins & Streamers
* **Zero Interaction Required:** Once set, the cameraman runs indefinitely.
* **Configurable:** Adjust speeds, distances, and active modes to fit your server's style.
* **Optimized:** Designed to run efficiently on Paper servers.

---

## 📖 Documentation & Commands

For a full list of commands, permissions, and detailed configuration guides, please visit our GitHub repository. We provide comprehensive documentation on how to customize every aspect of the camera behavior.

[**👉 View Full Documentation on GitHub**](https://github.com/shibomb/whole-minecraft-cameraman)

*(Please refer to the README on GitHub for installation instructions and command usage.)*
